project_dna.core_mission: Sub-second multi-channel inventory reconciliation and idempotent order routing for Shopify and WooCommerce.
project_dna.single_source_of_truth: PostgreSQL Master Inventory Ledger (append-only delta transactions).
key_invariants: No absolute overwrites from external storefront webhooks.
Constant-time HMAC validation before processing any payload.
Strict token bucket rate limiting to prevent HTTP 429 errors.

decisions_log.decision: Use quantityDelta (-N/+N) instead of absolute stock sets.
Enforce crypto.timingSafeEqual on all webhook signatures.
Node.js 24 native ES module execution with zero-transpiler latency.
